_comment: Settings of the agent (Claude Code started through claude-local). Model names refer to profiles in config\models.json. Details: docs\agent.md.

picker.label: Schnell
picker.description: local-fast: Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B, unzensiert, schneller, bei schweren Aufgaben schwaecher

stopCheck._comment: Closing check when the model wants to end an answer in which it changed files (scripts\hooks\Check-Stop.ps1). commands: check scripts looked for in the project folder, the first one found is run. maxBlocks: how often a failing check is handed back to the model. reminderFile: text in config\ the model gets once per answer, empty = no reminder. The text has points of the form '- [name] ...'. reminderPoints: a point is left out when a file changed in this answer matches doneWhenEdited (regular expression on the path); codeOnly: the point only counts when program code was changed (a file that matches no pattern). No open point = no reminder. Without reminderPoints the whole text is always sent.

review._comment: Second look (scripts\Invoke-Review.ps1): after an answer with a larger change a second local model checks the uncommitted git diff in a fresh context. The closing check runs it once per answer, after the project check passed and the reminder is through; errors go back to the author. model: profile or alias of the reviewer. minChangedLines: smaller changes are not reviewed. maxDiffChars: longer diffs are cut. maxFileChars: budget for the changed files in full (smallest first), so that contradictions to unchanged lines are visible. timeoutSeconds: includes loading the reviewer. instructionsFile: text in config\. Log: <installRoot>\logs\review.log.
